blocks.text: To enable the Dedicated IP feature for your Internet & SaaS (ZIA) tenant, contact your Zscaler Account team.
The IP Addresses page displays the IP addresses that are dedicated to your organization provisioned by Zscaler. Zscaler provisions these IP addresses at the data centers you choose.
The IP Addresses page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View and download the IP addresses that are dedicated to your organization at the Zscaler data centers that you choose.
Use the IP address dedicated to your tenant as the source IP address for the traffic that egresses through the Zscaler cloud.

blocks.text: On the IP Addresses page (Infrastructure > Internet & SaaS > Dedicated IP > IP Addresses), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Download all available data center details to a CSV file.
Modify the table and its columns.
View the list of all data centers and their IP addresses. For each data center, you can view:
Data Center: The location of the data center.
IPv4: The IPv4 address of the data center.
View the individual data center details.
Go to the Dedicated IP Gateways page.
